source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed Assert.ok checks selectAllAddressBooks.indeterminate directly after bulk deselection, but its message says the control should not be indeterminate. The same scenario expects one selected address book because the existing disabled book stays checked. The message should say: "Select All should be indeterminate because the existing address book remains selected." Preserve the true condition and selected count1; correct the diagnostic wording. The existing linked selection lessons retain the behavior and count contract. No test ran.
title: The disabled-book mixed-state assertion should say indeterminate
